Checksum

Definition

Checksum is a value calculated from file contents and compared later to detect accidental data change or corruption. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align delivery decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

  • 3-2-1 backup
